answer: Our decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol leverages a trellis-based reputation system, wherein agents' behavior is monitored through a network of verifiable delay attestations, effectively limiting the ocean of potential Sybil attacks. Agents' reputations are secured through zero-knowledge commitments, preventing malicious actors from manipulating their identities. By penalizing attempts to create new identities through a stake-slashing matrix, our system funnels malicious activity into an inlet of economic loss, ultimately discouraging Sybil resistance.
